name: Jakapil
isnote: Riguetti et al. 2022 recovered it as a basal thyreophoran outside Eurypoda; later analyses (Raven 2023, Fonseca 2024) are cited by the revision; placed in Thyreophora.
sum: Jakapil is a small Early Cretaceous thyreophoran from Patagonia with a predentary bone and large low osteoderms, probably walking on two legs.
wsnote: Estimates by the describers from femoral circumference; length less than 1.5 m (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: MPCA-PV-630, a partial skeleton with osteoderms and a complete lower jaw — Candeleros Formation, Neuquén, Argentina.
biology: Likely a bipedal stance like Scutellosaurus; it has a predentary bone, absent or cartilaginous in other basal thyreophorans.
author: Riguetti et al. 2022
